behavior: Borrow pinned immutable geometry in chunks of at most4 MiB across all four world streams. Charge actual mapped capacity to existing host16 MiB/process-staging64 MiB/GPU512 MiB admission, then hold source/destination GPU allocations through completion. Native render_with_submission returns false after an upload-only submission. Both native adapters record the ordinary queue receipt, discard the unpresented acquisition, retain damage and request the existing bounded nonblocking queue-retry path. No ordinary native handler sleeps or waits for readback.

Resume unchanged sources at their committed byte offset. A replaced or emptied source invalidates partial continuation; final rendering recomposes current state. Only a complete current-state render can reach native presentation. Warm camera/pointer frames add no world-copy submission.
The explicit offscreen/capture render convenience waits between chunks; native code uses the yielding API. This preserves existing capture callers without introducing a native wait loop.
